harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Published node4's HTTP service (port 8080) on node2's transit-side address 10.10.12.2:80 via OPNsense port-forward, and gave node3 (on lan-a) a static route through node1 to reach that address. Verified node3 reaches the service only via node2's address, never node4 directly. All four nodes were then restarted one at a time per the mandatory protocol, each with confirmed changed boot identity and confirmed post-restart recovery of configuration, service, and connectivity.
actions_performed: Mapped physical topology via ARP/tcpdump probing: node1.eth1<->node2.vtnet1 (transit), node1.eth2<->node3.enp8s0 (lan-a), node2.vtnet2<->node4.enp8s0 (lan-b)
Assigned static addressing: transit net 10.10.12.0/24 (node1=.1, node2=.2), lan-a net 10.10.13.0/24 (node1=.1, node3=.2), lan-b net 10.10.14.0/24 (node2=.1, node4=.2)
Configured node1 (VyOS) eth1/eth2 addresses via configure/commit/save; confirmed ip_forward=1 and no firewall filter blocking forwarding

Configured node2 (OPNsense) via config.xml edits: assigned opt1(vtnet1)/opt2(vtnet2) interfaces with static IPs, added a gateway object plus a static route to 10.10.13.0/24 via node1's transit address, added a port-forward (DNAT) rule on opt1 tcp/80 -> 10.10.14.2:8080, and a matching pass filter rule targeting the post-NAT destination (had to fix this since pf filter rules evaluate after NAT rewrite, so a rule matching the pre-NAT address never matched)

Configured node3 and node4 networking persistently via systemd-networkd unit files (overriding the wildcard DHCP=yes match); added node3's route to 10.10.12.0/24 via node1, and node4's route to 10.10.13.0/24 via node2 (fixed an asymmetric-routing dead end where node4's replies were taking its management default route instead of returning via node2)
Stood up a real HTTP service on node4:8080 via a systemd unit (demo-http.service) since none was running initially

Verified end-to-end: node3 curl to http://10.10.12.2:80/ succeeds and returns node4's content; node3 to node4's address 10.10.14.2:8080 directly times out (no route/path), confirming node3 only reaches the service by asking node2

Restarted node1, node2, node3, node4 one at a time (native reboot), polling each until exec was available again, confirming changed boot identity (boot_id or kern.boottime) and re-verifying config, service, and full two-hop connectivity after each restart

evidence.requirement: Baseline healthy state before any restarts (config, service, connectivity)
evidence.summary: Captured boot identity plus interface/route/service state on all 4 nodes, and a successful curl from node3 to the published service, immediately before starting the restart sequence.

evidence.requirement: Service published on node2's transit address (port 80) forwarding to node4:8080, and node3 reaching it via node2 rather than node4 directly
evidence.summary: curl http://10.10.12.2:80/ from node3 returns node4's content across 3 repeated calls; direct curl to node4's address 10.10.14.2:8080 from node3 times out, proving the two-hop-only path.

evidence.requirement: node1 given a route enabling node3 to reach node2's transit address
evidence.summary: node1's eth1 (transit, 10.10.12.1/24) and eth2 (lan-a, 10.10.13.1/24) addresses configured and committed on VyOS, giving it directly-connected routes to both segments; node3 given a matching static route to 10.10.12.0/24 via node1.

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart acknowledgment, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 2674ee60...; reboot command acknowledged; immediate re-check still showed old boot_id (not yet restarted) then connection timed out during reboot; post-poll boot_id changed to 91c69730... with fresh uptime; interfaces/forwarding and service reachability confirmed recovered.

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart acknowledgment, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline kern.boottime 14:59:15; reboot command issued (SSH session dropped, confirming restart in progress); post-poll kern.boottime changed to 15:13:22; interface IPs, NAT rule, and static route confirmed restored from config.xml, and service reachable end-to-end again.

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart acknowledgment, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 37344ae4...; reboot acknowledged then connection timed out; post-poll boot_id changed to b05cce6b... with fresh uptime; enp8s0 address and static route to transit net confirmed restored via systemd-networkd persisted unit, and service reachable again.

evidence.requirement: node4 restart: healthy baseline, restart acknowledgment, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id df9e2dce...; reboot acknowledged (connection reset confirming restart in progress); post-poll boot_id changed to f66d0af0... with fresh uptime; enp8s0 address, route to lan-a, and demo-http.service (enabled unit) confirmed restored/active; final end-to-end curl from node3 through node2 succeeded again post-restart.
